question: If (sin β + cosec β)² + (sec β - cos β)² = a + tan² β + cot² β, then the value of a is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put β = 45° in the given equation.

LHS = (1/√2 + √2)² + (√2 − 1/√2)² = (3/√2)² + (1/√2)² = 9/2 + 1/2 = 5

RHS = a + tan² 45° + cot² 45° = a + 1 + 1 = a + 2

Equating LHS and RHS: a + 2 = 5 ⇒ a = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(sin β + cosec β)² + (sec β − cos β)² = a + tan² β + cot² β

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

sin² β + cos² β = 1

sec² β = 1 + tan² β

cosec² β = 1 + cot² β

**Calculations:**

⇒ LHS = (sin² β + cosec² β + 2 × sin β × cosec β) + (sec² β + cos² β − 2 × sec β × cos β)

⇒ LHS = sin² β + cosec² β + 2 + sec² β + cos² β − 2

⇒ LHS = (sin² β + cos² β) + cosec² β + sec² β

⇒ LHS = 1 + (1 + cot² β) + (1 + tan² β)

⇒ LHS = 3 + tan² β + cot² β

⇒ 3 + tan² β + cot² β = a + tan² β + cot² β

⇒ a = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identities

sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ, 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ

Reciprocal Trigonometric Ratios

sin θ = 1 ÷ cosec θ, cos θ = 1 ÷ sec θ, tan θ = 1 ÷ cot θ

Important Result

(sin θ + cosec θ)² + (cos θ + sec θ)² = 7 + tan² θ + cot² θ
